documents.text: Provider will make the Larkspur Route Intelligence platform (the "Service") available to Customer and its authorized users in accordance with this agreement and each order form signed by both parties. Provider may update the Service from time to time, provided that no update will materially reduce the functionality of the Service during a paid term.

Provider will make the Larkspur Route Intelligence platform (the "Service") available to Customer, its affiliates and their authorized users in accordance with this agreement and each order form signed by both parties. Provider may update the Service from time to time, provided that no update will materially reduce the functionality of the Service during a paid term.

request.instructions: Document v1 is one clause of the agreement we sent. Document v2 is the same clause in the copy the counterparty returned. Decide whether v2 says the same thing as v1. They conflict when v2 changes an obligation, a right, an amount, a rate, a period, a party, a place, a limit, or who bears a risk, even if only one number or one word differs. Spelling corrections, punctuation, capitalisation, number formatting such as 'thirty (30)' versus '30', and a faithful rewording that keeps the same obligation are the same, not a conflict.
